creatorNote: Start learning with what's here. If it helps you, pay us back by sharing our content. When you're ready to go deeper, we'll help you take the next step.
intro: Start with Community. Add hands-on projects, live office hours and personal coaching when you’re ready.
billingNote: Annual savings apply to Builder. Guided is billed monthly or quarterly. All prices are in USD.
availabilityNote: Builder and Guided are coming soon. Their benefits are being prepared; paid enrollment and checkout are not open.

plans.detailMonthly: Planned price: $20 for one month of Builder access, or $15/month locked in as a founding member. Your own lab hardware, software and hosting are separate.
plans.detailAnnual: Pay $180 for 12 months and save $60 compared with 12 monthly payments. Founding members will pay $144/year. Your own lab hardware, software and hosting are separate.

plans.name: Guided
plans.tagline: Build a portfolio employers can see.
plans.chargeMonthly: Or $267 per quarter (save 10%): one full portfolio track. Seats will be limited.
features: A portfolio track: Build, Harden, Authorize, Capstone
Group coaching calls every other week
A written review every other week, with peer review in between
One in-depth project review a month, up to 10 pages
plans.detailMonthly: Work through a four-phase portfolio track with group coaching every other week, a 1:1 call each month, written reviews every other week with peer review between, and an in-depth project review and a resume review each month. Seats will be limited so every review gets real attention.
plans.renewMonthly: Planned billing: renews at $99/month, or $267/quarter. Cancel, pause or move to Builder online before renewal; access continues through the paid period.
